args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy of v2.3.1 (error rate 18%, running in us-east, us-west, eu-west). v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy release. Rollback verified as rolled out in all regions. Follow-up: confirm health/error rate recovery and investigate root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **Before:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. Health checks were failing and the error rate was 18%.
- **Version picked:** The release history wasn't listed in date order, so I went by the sequence numbers. The two latest releases, v2.3.1 and v2.3.1-rc, were both unhealthy. The newest healthy release was v2.3.0.
- **Rollback:** All three regions are now on v2.3.0. A fresh status check shows checkout-api passing health checks, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) explains that v2.3.1 failed health checks and that I rolled back to v2.3.0. It also lists follow-ups: keep watching that the service stays healthy, and find out what's wrong with v2.3.1 before deploying it again.

content.text: The list isn't in sequence order, but by `seq` the most recent healthy release is v2.3.0 (seq 1). Both later releases, v2.3.1-rc (seq 2) and v2.3.1 (seq 3), are unhealthy.
